description: Transitive closure, stable topological order, cycles, and deep chains

files.FLOW.md: closure(requested, dependencies) returns the set containing requested names and all transitively required dependencies. plan returns that closure in topological order: dependencies precede consumers, choosing the lexicographically smallest ready node at every step. Inputs are a list of names and a dict mapping known names to dependency lists; duplicates are harmless. Unknown requested names or reachable unknown dependencies raise ValueError. A cycle in the requested closure raises ValueError from plan; unrelated cycles do not prevent a valid requested plan. Neither function mutates inputs. Empty request returns empty. Support chains of at least 1500 nodes without recursive-stack overflow. No filesystem/network work.
files.AGENTS.md: Isolated evaluation fixture. Only edit graph.py and planner.py. FLOW.md is the authoritative contract. Run python -B checks.py. Preserve all other files and the installed skill. No network, other repositories, global skills or extra agents.
